description: This file defines the CommandLine class for building and parsing command line arguments, including handling switches, arguments, and singleton management for the current process's command line.

classes.name: base::CommandLine
classes.description: A class for constructing, parsing, and managing command line arguments and switches, with platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: StringTypeToUTF8
methods.description: Converts platform-specific string type to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: UTF8ToStringType
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to platform-specific string type.

methods.name: set_slash_is_not_a_switch
methods.description: Configures argument parsing behavior on Windows to treat slashes as non-switch characters.

methods.name: InitUsingArgvForTesting
methods.description: Initializes command line parsing for testing with given argc and argv.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton command line for the current process.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the singleton command line for the current process.

methods.name: ForCurrentProcess
methods.description: Returns the singleton command line for the current process.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Creates a CommandLine object from a command line string (Windows only).

methods.name: GetCommandLineString
methods.description: Returns the command line as a string.

methods.name: GetArgumentsString
methods.description: Returns the arguments part of the command line as a string.

methods.name: GetArgs
methods.description: Returns the remaining arguments as a vector.

methods.name: GetProgram
methods.description: Gets the program part of the command line.

methods.name: SetProgram
methods.description: Sets the program part of the command line.

methods.name: HasSwitch
methods.description: Checks if a switch is present.

methods.name: GetSwitchValueString
methods.description: Gets the value of a switch as a string.

methods.name: GetSwitchValuePath
methods.description: Gets the value of a switch as a FilePath.

methods.name: GetSwitchValueNative
methods.description: Gets the value of a switch in native string type.

methods.name: GetSwitchValueStrings
methods.description: Gets all values for a switch as strings.

methods.name: GetSwitchValuesNative
methods.description: Gets all values for a switch in native string type.

methods.name: AppendSwitch
methods.description: Appends a switch with optional value.

methods.name: AppendSwitchPath
methods.description: Appends a switch with a FilePath value.

methods.name: AppendSwitchNative
methods.description: Appends a switch with a native string value.

methods.name: AppendSwitch
methods.description: Appends a switch with a string value.

methods.name: CopySwitchesFrom
methods.description: Copies switches from another CommandLine object.

methods.name: GetArgs
methods.description: Returns remaining arguments.

methods.name: AppendArg
methods.description: Appends an argument.

methods.name: AppendArgPath
methods.description: Appends a FilePath argument.

methods.name: AppendArgNative
methods.description: Appends a native string argument.

methods.name: AppendArguments
methods.description: Appends arguments from another CommandLine.

methods.name: PrependWrapper
methods.description: Inserts a wrapper command before the current command.

methods.name: ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a command line string into arguments (Windows only).
